blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Police arrested a man wanted for frustrated homicide at his residence in Magsingal, Ilocos Sur, on Sunday, Sept. 20. The Magsingal Municipal Police Station, assisted by personnel from the 1st Ilocos Sur Provincial Mobile Force Company and the Provincial Intelligence Unit of the Ilocos Sur Police Provincial Office (ISPPO), served the warrant and took the suspect into custody.
